\ednentry{
  id = {EDN-96},
  title = {The web page ships in the API image as plain files, without a framework},
  date = {2026-11-02},
  milestone = {Other},
  topic = {Frontend, Deployment},
  participants = {@lukas2510 asked for the page and delegated it under his account; the AI chose the stack and the delivery path},
  decision = {A static page of hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript with self-hosted Instrument Serif and Sans and a hand-drawn SVG waterfall.
The API serves it from memory at \texttt{/\allowbreak{}} to browsers, behind the unchanged nginx, so it deploys and rolls back with the API image.
Its requests carry \texttt{X-\allowbreak{}Client: web-\allowbreak{}ui}, stored in the prediction log for M6.},
  rationale = {\emph{Alternatives considered:}
\begin{itemize}[leftmargin=*, topsep=2pt]
\item nginx serving the files: nginx.conf reaches the VM only by rerunning the bootstrap, and its own image was rejected before (EDN-95).
\item Alpine.js: its standard build needs \texttt{unsafe-\allowbreak{}eval} in the Content Security Policy, for one form.
\item Tailwind with DaisyUI: a build step and default looks for 1,047 lines of CSS.
\item A Streamlit or Gradio container: a new service on a VM that M6 needs.
\end{itemize}
\par
\emph{Why:} Only the API image moves to the VM on a merge, so the page goes live with no manual step and a rollback restores the matching page.
A first visit loads 64 KB plus the 51 KB OpenAPI document; nginx stayed at 15.0 MiB of 64 MiB after 2,100 page requests.},
  ai = {Alternative generation, Alternative assessment, Recommendation, Solution generation},
  response = {Accepted},
  assessment = {AI found that a change to nginx.conf never reaches the VM in CD, chose the delivery through the API image, designed and built the page, and measured payload and memory.
Two independent review agents (design and code) raised two blocking and eleven should-fix points, all fixed; no human code review.},
  aievidence = {Claude Code session of 2026-11-02 on issue \#269, which asks for a page that looks ``professional, modern and polished''; Lukas's prompt (translated from German): ``I want a very good frontend that looks high quality''.},
  evidence = {\href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/issues/269}{Issue \#269}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/web-ui.md}{web page docs}, \href{https://github.com/mlops-2627q1-mds-upc/MLOPS_Recommenditos/blob/main/docs/docs/deployment.md\#the-stack}{deployment docs}.},
